# Dubbing and translation

**Multilingual shorts and voice-overs: glossary, cultural check, consented voices, dubs, lip-sync, subtitles, platform language tools.**

Makes multilingual versions of shorts, explainers and voice-overs — picking languages from audience data, a glossary and cultural check before translating, voice-cloning consent, dubbed audio in the same character voice with @useclaudia/media, lip-sync or cut-around for on-camera speech, subtitles per language, and each platform's own language features (YouTube multi-language audio and auto-dubbing, Meta AI translations) with their labels. Use when someone wants to dub a video, translate a short, add a Spanish or Hindi version, upload a second audio track, add subtitles in other languages, or clone a voice for another language.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 1–2 h per language for a short, then 20 min each | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli`, `@useclaudia/social` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Pick languages from data
2. Lock the source and a glossary
3. Translate, then check culture
4. Settle voice and consent
5. Generate the dubbed lines
6. Fix the lips or cut around them
7. Make subtitles per language
8. Publish with platform language tools
9. QA with a native speaker and log it

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/dubbing-and-translation.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/dubbing-and-translation.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/dubbing-and-translation.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/dubbing-and-translation.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill dubbing-and-translation`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `dubbing-and-translation.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/dubbing-and-translation`.
